stories.title: CPSC Recalls Two Baby Bath Seats Over Drowning Risk — What Parents Need to Know

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
RECALL: Two baby bath seat models sold on Amazon have been recalled by the CPSC for drowning and entrapment risk.

If you have an YCXXKJ or NFSVLB bath seat, stop using it now.

Contact the seller for a full refund. #BabySafety #CPSCRecall

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
YCXXKJ bath seat (BenTalk on Amazon): ~9,000 units recalled. Tips over — drowning risk.

NFSVLB bath seat (Amazon): Leg openings let infants slip through — entrapment and drowning risk.

Both sold 2024–2025. Stop use. Get a refund. Details at cpsc.gov. #CPSCRecall

article.headline: CPSC Recalls Two Baby Bath Seat Models Sold on Amazon Over Drowning and Entrapment Risk

stories.title: AAP 2026 Vaccine Schedule Recommends More Shots Than CDC — What Colorado Families Should Know

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The AAP's 2026 vaccine schedule covers 17 diseases — more than the CDC's, which dropped hep A/B, flu, rotavirus, RSV, and meningococcal.

Colorado CDPHE backs the AAP list. Ask your pediatrician which schedule they follow. #ChildHealth #Colorado

stories.title: Cool Science Festival Returns to Colorado Springs — Free STEAM Events Oct. 3–18

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The Cool Science Festival runs Oct. 3–18 in Colorado Springs — 16 days of mostly free STEAM events across the city.

Carnival Day at UCCS kicks it off Saturday. WMMI, Ivywild, and USAFA have events through Oct. 18.

Full schedule at coolscience.org. #COSKids #STEAM
